t: TRGP Q3 Earnings Beat on Permian Growth and Higher Fees
desc: Targa Resources (TRGP) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.04 per share, beating estimates by 8.19%, with revenues up 34.9% to $5.6 billion. Record Permian inlet volumes and higher midstream fees drove adjusted EBITDA up 18% to $1.5B. The company raised its 2026 EBITDA outlook to at least $6B and increased its quarterly dividend by 25% to $1.25 per share, with plans for a 20% annualized dividend increase to $6 per share in 2027.
